data.researchQuestion: I want to research the range of cultural influence of David Bowie

plan.title: Cultural Influence and Material Traces of David Bowie
plan.summary: This workflow gathers evidence of David Bowie's cultural reach by examining his artistic output, fashion, scientific/industrial connections, and literary mentions. It uses a combination of sources to trace his influence across art, design, science, and language.

comment.title: Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A)
comment.body: Excellent for tracing fashion, costume design, textiles, and applied arts elements of his public persona.

comment.title: Science Museum Group (SMG)
comment.body: Useful for finding connections to technology, scientific instruments, or industrial aspects of his career.

comment.title: Europeana
comment.body: A broad source for cross-national cultural artifacts, photographs, and historical documents related to his global influence.

comment.title: Literary and Linguistic Data Service (LLDS)
comment.body: To find linguistic traces, quotes, or mentions of his name in historical UK texts and corpora.

comment.title: Cultural Influence Overview
comment.body: A consolidated table showing the diverse material, linguistic, and artistic evidence of David Bowie's cultural impact.
